files.prepended_export_notice: Public source-text preservation. This is the submitted theorem, with the one source-program reproduction direction replaced as recorded in [the transformation manifest](../../SOURCE_EXPORT_TRANSFORMS.json). Read [the accepted restricted audit](../../reviews/03_phase_cone.md): gain-graph switching is classical; O(N+q) charges discrete preprocessing only; rigorous threshold certification and magnitude validation carry separate costs. Prior unitary-collinear and complex phase-averaging theorems retain their accepted scopes. Source-reported tests are historical. No source programs are included, and preserving this text is not a universal FFT lower bound or priority certification.

files.prepended_export_notice: Public source-text preservation. The mathematical source body below is unchanged. Read [the scoped audit](../../reviews/04_jordan_jets.md) and [independent second review](../../reviews/05_jordan_second_review.md) for the accepted qualifications. In particular, the exponential-generating restatement needs invertible factorials (d < characteristic in positive characteristic); a finite union of proper finite-field subspaces need not be proper, so use the review’s corrected piecewise counting bound; and greedy piecewise recognition is an accepted-input guarantee, not a complete recognizer. Source benchmark numbers are unrerun author reports, and the padded 2N-output crossover is not an ordinary N-output speedup. No source programs are included.
